about.title: A bit about me
about.body: I’m a Frontend/Fullstack developer with 4+ years building web and mobile applications with React, Next.js, and React Native (Expo). I specialize in UI architecture, scalable component systems, and performance optimization for high-demand products. I’ve worked with microservices and complex data flows, including real-time integrations with Firebase, and I also get involved in delivery: CI/CD, Docker, and automated deployments. I like leaving strong foundations (standards, best practices, and a solid DX) so teams can move fast without sacrificing quality.
